name: ggml
one_liner: A low-level math engine that lets AI models run efficiently on everyday computers and phones instead of needing expensive specialized hardware.
buyer: No direct business buyer — this is foundational infrastructure used by other developers to build AI tools (like llama.cpp), not a product a company would purchase on its own.
business_use_cases: A hardware startup building an AI-powered device uses it to run models efficiently on constrained chips without cloud costs.
A privacy-focused app vendor uses it to run AI features fully on-device so no customer data ever leaves the phone.
A developer tools company builds a specialized fine-tuning product on top of it rather than writing their own tensor math from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: Offer consulting to help hardware companies optimize their on-device AI using this library

steal_this: Be honest: there is no direct weekend business here. It's plumbing other products are built on, not a product itself. Low opportunity for a solo builder looking to make money this week.
